# Flow 4.1: Quota banner

Feature: `agent/4-quota/1-quota-banner.md` · PR: https://example.invalid/notifications/pull/214
Before pinned at `a71c30d4` · After pinned at `5c8ad713`

## Before

The dashboard header renders with no quota awareness; the only reader of `notification_quota` is
the send path, which fails closed once the limit is reached.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["DashboardHeader.tsx · DashboardHeader<br/><a href='https://github.com/example-org/notifications/blob/a71c30d4/apps/dashboard/components/DashboardHeader.tsx#L18-L44'>L18-44</a>"]
  B["sendNotification.ts · sendNotification<br/><a href='https://github.com/example-org/notifications/blob/a71c30d4/apps/api/lib/sendNotification.ts#L60-L96'>L60-96</a>"]
  C["notification_quota (table)<br/><a href='https://github.com/example-org/notifications/blob/a71c30d4/supabase/migrations/0039_notification_quota.sql#L1-L22'>L1-22</a>"]
  A -->|"renders nav and avatar only"| A
  B -->|"reads used and limit, throws QuotaExceeded"| C
```

## After

The header asks a new hook for a quota status on every dashboard load, and renders one of three
states. Nothing on the send path changed: the banner is a second reader of the same row.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["DashboardHeader.tsx · DashboardHeader<br/><a href='https://github.com/example-org/notifications/blob/5c8ad713/apps/dashboard/components/DashboardHeader.tsx#L18-L52'>L18-52</a>"]
  D["QuotaBanner.tsx · QuotaBanner<br/><a href='https://github.com/example-org/notifications/blob/5c8ad713/apps/dashboard/components/QuotaBanner.tsx#L1-L74'>L1-74</a>"]
  E["useQuota.ts · useQuota<br/><a href='https://github.com/example-org/notifications/blob/5c8ad713/apps/dashboard/lib/useQuota.ts#L1-L58'>L1-58</a>"]
  F["route.ts · GET /api/quota<br/><a href='https://github.com/example-org/notifications/blob/5c8ad713/apps/api/routes/quota/route.ts#L1-L30'>L1-30</a>"]
  C["notification_quota (table)<br/><a href='https://github.com/example-org/notifications/blob/5c8ad713/supabase/migrations/0039_notification_quota.sql#L1-L22'>L1-22</a>"]
  A -->|"mounts the banner above the nav"| D
  D -->|"status: ok, warning or critical"| E
  E -->|"GET on dashboard load"| F
  F -->|"used and limit for the current period"| C
```

## What changed

- `DashboardHeader`: mounts `QuotaBanner`, which renders nothing at `ok`.
- `useQuota`: new hook, the only new read of `notification_quota` from the dashboard.
- `GET /api/quota`: new route, returns the period row and nothing else.
